channel.title: Projects on Keelan Reilly
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Keelan Reilly

item.title: Measured Tradeoffs and Decision Boundaries in FPGA MAC-Array Architectures
item.description: A measured study of how compute sharing alters resource usage, performance, and architectural choice in FPGA MAC arrays, with explicit decision boundaries and validity limits.

item.title: FPGA Market Data Parser (Low-Latency Pipeline)
item.description: This project implements a low-latency market data ingestion pipeline in SystemVerilog. I built it to understand how protocol handling, backpressure, and control timing shape end-to-end latency in real hardware pipelines.

item.title: Quantised CNN Inference Accelerator
item.description: A fixed-function FPGA CNN inference accelerator implemented in SystemVerilog. The project explores how architectural decisions around data layout, precision, and scheduling affect performance and flexibility.
